attorneys: Louis J. Caruso, Solicitor General of Michigan, argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the brief were Frank J. Kelley, Attorney General, and Thomas C. Nelson, Assistant Attorney General., John Nussbaumer argued the cause and filed a brief for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Justice Marshall took no part in the decision of this case.
